audience: accountants and businesses that keep their books in Yuki and want quick answers from their administration

useCases.title: Chase open sales invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists unpaid sales invoices with amounts and due dates, within a date range if you like, and finds the contact behind each one.

useCases.title: Review open purchase invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists the purchase invoices you still have to pay, with amounts, references and due dates, so you can plan payments.

useCases.title: Check ledger balances
useCases.text: The AI reads the chart of accounts, the balance of every ledger account on a date, and the transactions booked on one account.

useCases.title: Report net revenue
useCases.text: The AI gives the net revenue of an administration in a date range, and lists the administrations a key reaches, which suits accountants.

useCases.title: Find archived documents
useCases.text: The AI searches the document archive for invoices, receipts and statements, shows the details and gives a short-lived download link.
